sources.title: README.md · 0xSero/GLM-5.2-504B at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A 34%-expert-pruned GLM-5.2 that holds parity with the full unpruned model on a well-powered real-world eval — recovered by training only the router gates (0.016% of params), and quantized to NVFP4 for 8×B200-class serving.

sources.title: vroomfondel/glm-5.2-reap-504B-v2-W4A4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The base model 0xSero/glm-5.2-reap-504B-v2 is a 34%-expert-pruned GLM-5.2 (GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM, 78 layers + 1 MTP, DeepSeek-style MLA + DSA sparse indexer, hidden 6144), recovered to near-parity by training only the router gates.
